summary: 58-year-old woman, non-smoker: 10 weeks of dry, tickly nocturnal cough that began a few weeks after ramipril was started. No haemoptysis, fever or weight loss. The HPI step offers the cough history, not abdominal SOCRATES.

inputs.hpi: Ten weeks of a dry, tickly cough, worse at night, which began a few weeks after ramipril was started for hypertension. No sputum, no haemoptysis, no fever, no breathlessness, no wheeze, no weight loss. No heartburn. Never smoked.

exam.respiratory: Chest clear. No wheeze, no crackles.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: ACE-inhibitor induced cough
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Chronic dry cough starting after ramipril; no red flags. Probable ACE-inhibitor cough.

mustRankTopK.note: Cough history chips: timing ">3 weeks", "After starting ACEi", character "Dry" (DiagnosticDatabase cough pool).

mustRankTopK.knownGapNote: pane-engine models no ACE-inhibitor cough (or any chronic-cough cause): the cough frame answers reach acei_arb_use, cough and chronic_course, and PANE ranks GORD / peptic ulcer / lipoma. Needs a pane cough module (sign-off list, history-by-complaint.md).

guideline.name: ERS guidelines on the diagnosis and treatment of chronic cough in adults and children
guideline.section: Chronic cough > 8 weeks; ACE-inhibitor cough: stop the ACE inhibitor (resolves within weeks)
guideline.citation: Morice AH, et al. Eur Respir J 2020;55:1901136.

guideline.name: BTS guidelines: Recommendations for the management of cough in adults
guideline.section: Duration bands: acute < 3 weeks, subacute 3–8 weeks, chronic > 8 weeks
guideline.citation: Morice AH, et al. Thorax 2006;61 Suppl 1:i1–24.

rationale: The cough frame records duration (BTS/ERS bands), character and the ACE-inhibitor exposure; on iOS these chips reach the cough pool features (">3 weeks", "After starting ACEi", "Dry"). The web pane engine models no ACE-inhibitor cough, so the web side only checks that the frame answers reach acei_arb_use (history-frames test).
